mechanism: Both agents are nephrotoxic; amikacin causes dose-dependent aminoglycoside nephrotoxicity while micafungin can cause acute kidney injury, increasing risk of renal impairment when combined.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, BUN, and amikacin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antifungal if renal function declines; adjust amikacin dosing based on renal function.
